name: forward_to_inner_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, passing the result registers through unchanged. It is a trampoline with no logic of its own.

name: guard_task_state_update
description: Clears several per-frame state words and copies a saved pointer. When a flag is set, it finds the current task, saves one of its fields, forbids multitasking, sets that field to all ones, then restores it and permits multitasking again.

name: insert_ranked_record_entry
description: Walks a table of 34-byte records to find the first slot whose stored value is not below the new one, then fills that slot with the value, a 12-character name copied from the source (padded with spaces when a flag is clear) and the source's numeric fields.

name: shift_record_rows_down
description: Copies 34-byte table rows one position downward, from the row before the given index back toward the top, to open a free slot for an insertion.

name: read_player_name_entry
description: Shows the name entry prompt, blanks a 12-character name field, then reads keystrokes from the keyboard serial register. It accepts digits and letters as uppercase, handles delete and return keys, and redraws the text until the player confirms.

name: preserve_state_word_around_call
description: Saves a 16-bit state word from a record, calls another routine, and writes the saved word back so the call leaves it unchanged.

name: clear_bitplane_text_rows
description: Clears 12-byte blocks in each of four bitplanes (40 bytes apart) for six rows of a 160-byte-per-row screen buffer. It then sets two marker bytes in a record, calls another routine, and restores them.

name: invert_bitplane_cell_column
description: When the column index is below twelve, XORs a byte into the same column of six rows in the fourth bitplane, then calls a helper and inverts a stored byte.

name: translate_text_character_entry
description: Looks up the character at a text position in a 39-entry character table and writes the table entry at the matching offset back to that position in the text buffer and its shadow copy.

name: update_slot_list_and_timers
description: Resets timers and state counters, walks a linked list of entries assigning up to three of them positions and values from a source table, clears a pending flag on tagged entries, and then calls helpers that advance the frame's counters and keyboard reads.

name: jump_to_object_update_step
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: runs one update step for an active object that has room: it calls the object's own update handler, then on alternating frames takes an entry from a free pool and initialises it from the object's position. A screen-mode flag switches it to alternate handler pointers.

name: jump_to_object_update_step
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: same object update step as its sibling routines, used as a second handler copy. It calls the object's update handler and, on alternating frames, takes a free pool entry and initialises it from the object's position.

name: jump_to_object_update_step
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: another copy of the same object update step used as a handler. It calls the object's update handler and, on alternating frames, takes a free pool entry and initialises it from the object's position.

name: update_object_spawn_step_offset
description: Object update step with the same structure as its siblings, but the spawned entry is placed at a different horizontal offset. It calls the object's update handler and then alternates between two spawn paths.

name: jump_to_object_update_result
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: runs the active object's update handler when the object is active and below its limit, then returns the handler's result; otherwise it returns the input value unchanged. It also contains the alternating spawn path.

name: update_object_spawn_step_fallback
description: Object update step like its siblings, with a fallback path: when a counter word is clear, it stores a fixed timing value and a pointer from a table, then returns.

name: dispatch_through_pointers
description: Calls one helper, then calls through a pointer loaded from memory and a second jump target that the decompiler could not recover. It acts as a plain dispatcher.

name: run_with_adjusted_pointer
description: Saves a pointer word from a record, replaces it with a global value minus two, calls two helpers, then restores the saved word.

name: jump_to_adjusted_pointer_call
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: saves a pointer word from a record, calls a helper, sets the word to a table value minus two, calls two helpers, then restores the saved word.

name: run_with_adjusted_pointer_alt
description: Saves a pointer word from a record, calls a helper, sets the word to a table value minus two, calls two helpers and restores it. It is a duplicate of its neighbouring routine.

name: jump_to_adjusted_pointer_call
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: saves a pointer word from a record, replaces it with a table value minus two, calls two helpers, then restores the saved word. It is a copy of its neighbouring routines.

name: run_adjusted_pointer_copy_two
description: Saves a pointer word, sets it to a table value minus two, calls two helpers, then restores it. The body repeats the adjusted-pointer pattern used by its neighbours.

name: advance_object_animation_state
description: Reads an object's state byte and, depending on its value, either counts an event or steps the object through its states. It calls helpers that update the object's handler pointers and counters.

name: step_object_table_state
description: When the object's active state byte matches, it reads the next entry of the object's state table, deactivating the object at an end marker and otherwise storing the entry, resetting the timing word and running helpers.

name: deactivate_object_handlers
description: For each of three handler objects that is set and not already marked, sets its state byte to a deactivated value.

name: reset_object_state_block
description: Optionally swaps in a saved object pointer, zeroes the object's two counters, copies three position words into its record, calls three helpers, then clears 36 consecutive long words of the shared state block.

name: reset_object_state_block_plain
description: Performs the same object counter reset and state block clear as its sibling routine, without the saved-pointer swap.

name: draw_alien_count_and_points
description: Compares two counters and, when they differ, writes the points and the 'OF 20 ALIENS' status text, computing a value from 100 minus a counter and waiting on a timer while the digits are drawn.

name: jump_to_longword_row_copy
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: copies rows of 32-bit words between two buffers when both addresses are word-aligned and the width is large enough, moving eight longwords at a time in unrolled loops. Otherwise it returns without copying.

name: jump_to_longword_row_copy
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: the same aligned longword row copy as its neighbour, used as an alternate entry point by several callers.

name: jump_to_longword_row_copy
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: copies rows of 32-bit words between two aligned buffers, like its neighbours, but only when the width exceeds a threshold. Otherwise it returns without copying.

name: jump_to_digit_string_copy
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: writes a digit character derived from a register value into a text buffer, copies a zero-terminated string from a source table after it, and sets a ready flag.

name: count_event_and_dispatch_object
description: Increments a counter in the current object unless its disable flag is set, calls an update helper, and when a state word is set it swaps in the saved object pointers and calls helpers for each.

name: redraw_points_and_bonus_text
description: Updates the points status line by incrementing a counter, waiting on a timer, and redrawing the points, alien count and bonus text strings through the text routines.

name: jump_to_handler_swap_call
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: calls an update helper, then when a state word is set it swaps in the two saved object pointers, calls the helper for each, and restores the original object pointer.

name: initialise_object_from_state_words
description: Waits for the blitter busy flag to clear, then copies a set of state words into the object's fields and computes its position as the sum of two offsets.

name: choose_pool_slot_pointer
description: When an enable word is set and a state byte matches a fixed value, it checks three slots in turn and picks the first empty one; otherwise it uses the default slot. It returns a pointer computed from the index and a base.

name: select_pool_slot_by_xor
description: XORs a 16-bit word with a stored value to form a new index, then applies the same slot selection as its sibling routine.

name: refresh_pool_entry_with_swaps
description: Calls an update helper and, when a state word is set, swaps in saved object pointers, calls helpers to refresh the entry, and restores the original pointer.

name: jump_to_pending_entry_scan
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: returns early when the current object is disabled or its counter is below a threshold. Otherwise it scans a table ended by a sentinel byte and updates the matching entries.

name: update_object_with_key_scan
description: Returns early when the object is disabled or below its threshold. Otherwise it scans a sentinel-ended table, runs text and handler helpers, and reads the keyboard serial register through helpers.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Does nothing and returns. It is a placeholder entry called from one place.

name: toggle_state_and_copy_table
description: Calls four helpers, waits for a flag word to become nonzero, toggles bit value 4 in a state word, and when the result is zero copies six words from a table into a destination area.

name: jump_to_digit_string_copy
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: writes a digit derived from a register value into a text buffer and copies a zero-terminated string after it, the same as its sibling routine, used as a second entry.

name: init_object_speed_and_handler
description: Initialises an object by setting a counter to sixteen, installing an update handler, setting its speed word to half of a stored value and its step to four.

name: advance_object_step_counter
description: When the blocked flag is clear, increments the object's step counter up to five. For steps other than zero and one it calls a helper for each intermediate step.

name: advance_object_step_counter_plain
description: Increments the object's step counter up to five and calls helpers for each intermediate step, the same as its sibling without the block check.

name: track_best_table_entry
description: Looks up a table value for an index. With no saved entry it stores the index and value; otherwise it keeps the index with the larger table value.

name: advance_object_frame_counter
description: When the object's mode byte equals a fixed value, resets a counter, increments a secondary counter at the frame limit, and advances the frame index, capped at four.

name: set_next_mode_flag_bit
description: Sets the first clear bit of a set of mode flags in priority order, so each call marks the next step of the object's mode byte.

name: set_mode_flag_bits_tail
description: Sets the next clear mode flag bit from a fixed priority list that starts at the fourth bit, so each call marks the next step of the object's mode byte.

name: set_mode_flag_from_eight
description: Sets the next clear mode flag bit from a fixed priority list that starts at the eighth bit, so each call marks the next step of the object's mode byte.

name: set_mode_flag_from_four
description: Sets the next clear mode flag bit from a fixed priority list that starts at the fourth bit, so each call marks the next step of the object's mode byte.

name: set_mode_flag_from_two
description: Sets the next clear mode flag bit from a fixed priority list that starts at the second bit, then calls a helper and, when the lowest flag is set, writes values into a linked record.

name: set_low_mode_flag_update
description: Sets the lowest mode flag bit, calls a helper, and when that bit is set writes fixed word values into a linked record.

name: set_object_flag_bit_zero
description: Sets bit zero of a 16-bit flag word in the object.

name: set_object_type_four_handler
description: Keeps the upper bits of a mode word, sets its type value to four, installs an update handler, and sets a timing counter to three.

name: set_object_type_two_handler
description: Keeps the upper bits of a mode word, sets its type value to two, installs an update handler, and sets a timing counter to two.

name: step_object_position_toward_target
description: Increments a position word of the object by one when it has not yet reached a target derived from a stored speed word.

name: increment_counter_up_to_eight
description: Increments the object's counter by one until it reaches eight.

name: decrement_counter_down_to_one
description: Decrements the object's counter by one while it is above one.

name: set_object_type_wide_handler
description: Keeps the upper bits of a mode word, sets its type value to 256, installs a new update handler, sets a speed word from a quarter of a stored value and sets a timing counter to four.

name: set_object_type_128_handler
description: Keeps the upper bits of a mode word, sets its type value to 128, installs a new update handler, sets a speed word from a quarter of a stored value and sets a timing counter to three.

name: add_500_to_object_word
description: Adds 500 to a 16-bit value stored in the object.

name: set_object_type_64_handler
description: Keeps the upper bits of a mode word, sets its type value to 64, installs a new update handler, sets a speed word from a quarter of a stored value and sets a timing counter to two.

name: set_object_type_32_handler
description: Keeps the upper bits of a mode word, sets its type value to 32, installs the update handler, sets a speed word from a quarter of a stored value and sets a timing counter to three.

name: run_timed_draw_sequence
description: Calls a fixed sequence of helpers with a timing wait, sets a state word to eight, then loops over a set of counters and runs one of several helper calls on each pass until the sequence finishes.

name: fill_entries_while_flag_set
description: While a bit in the input value is set, writes a fixed code byte into a table entry chosen by a counter and advances the counter, then calls two helpers.

name: poll_input_bit_until_change
description: Tests a bit of the object's state value and, in a loop, waits on a timer word and calls helpers until the bit condition changes. It touches the CIA chip registers.

name: clear_text_buffer_rows
description: Fills six rows of a text buffer, each 29 bytes long and spaced 35 bytes apart, with space characters.

name: copy_text_rows_from_table
description: Copies consecutive 27-byte source rows into a text buffer, placing each row 35 bytes after the previous one, until a source row begins with a zero byte.

name: run_state_timed_animation
description: Chooses one of two state values by comparing object pointers, then in a loop waits on a timer word and calls helpers until the state sequence is done.

name: loop_state_timed_animation
description: While a bit of the input value is set, alternates two state values and calls timer wait and helper routines in a loop.

name: step_state_handler_on_bit
description: Tests a bit of the object's flags and, when it is clear, selects one of two saved object pointers based on the state byte, calls helpers with it, and loops. It touches the CIA chip registers.

name: restore_saved_object_pointer
description: Calls three helpers and then restores the object pointer saved in a global word.

name: compute_scaled_state_value
description: When the input is nonzero, combines a stored 32-bit word with a fixed bit mask and doubles it through an add-with-carry chain with a second stored word, producing a scaled 32-bit value.

name: latch_pending_object_fields
description: Moves a pending value into an active field and clears the pending word. When the active value is nonzero, it copies three stored long words into the object's fields and calls a helper.

name: process_frame_input_and_redraw
description: Large per-frame routine that reads the keyboard serial register and the CIA chip, updates a six-digit counter text field, and calls about thirty helpers to update objects and redraw the screen.

name: rotate_and_clamp_position_word
description: Reads a 32-bit stored value, halves it when a flag is set, swaps its 16-bit halves, and uses the upper half in a range check against eleven before updating object positions through a helper.

name: run_game_state_frame_update
description: Large frame routine that reads the keyboard serial register and the CIA chip and calls about forty helpers to update objects, timers and the screen state.

name: jump_to_points_dispatcher
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: adds fifty, ten or one hundred to an object's point total according to a kind value in a register. For the other kinds it writes a fixed set of sprite parameters, sets a state word and returns.

name: jump_to_points_dispatcher
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: adds fifty, ten or one hundred to an object's point total according to a kind value in a register. For the other kinds it writes a fixed set of sprite parameters, sets a state word and returns.

name: dispatch_points_and_spawn_effects
description: Adds fifty, ten or a larger point amount to an object's point total depending on a kind value, then runs seven helper routines that update the object's on-screen entry and effects.

name: update_timed_event_thresholds
description: When a counter has advanced by more than fifty since its last recorded value, records the new value and calls helpers chosen by threshold comparisons, updating the timed event state.

name: jump_to_indexed_word_read
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: reads a 16-bit value from a table at an index held in a register and continues into the routine that uses it.

name: process_active_object_list
description: Walks the linked list of objects and, for each entry whose kind byte is one, calls helpers that update its drawing and position from its fields.

name: find_object_at_grid_cell
description: Walks the object list to find an active entry whose stored horizontal and vertical positions match the grid cell computed from two input values, each cell thirty units wide with a fixed offset.

name: accumulate_active_object_counts
description: Clears a 27-entry table, then walks the object list and, for each active entry, updates the table cell indexed by that entry's field.

name: draw_points_in_fifty_steps
description: Splits a point value into fifty-unit steps, accumulating one hundred per step, and draws the result as seven text digits through ten helper routines.

name: copy_indexed_entry_into_object
description: Reads a 16-bit value from a table indexed by a register and stores it, with a few related words, into the object's fields.

name: latch_pending_entry_words
description: Moves a pending word into an active field and, when that field is nonzero, copies a set of long words into the object's record and calls a helper.

name: store_value_to_entry_slots
description: Stores one register value into a fixed set of table slots at several offsets, repeating the write for each slot group the caller uses.

name: store_fixed_word_pattern_table
description: Writes a fixed list of sixteen-bit constants into a table of slots, the same entries on every call.

name: wait_flag_call_until_zero
description: Loops while a register value is nonzero: waits for a flag word to become set, clears it and calls a helper each time.

name: wait_flag_call_zero_copy
description: The same wait-and-call loop as its sibling routine, used from several callers.

name: swap_object_pointer_then_call
description: When a state word is set, temporarily swaps in a saved object pointer, calls helpers, then restores the original pointer.

name: draw_rank_title_text
description: Draws a rank title chosen by a counter from a list of four rank names, from ensign to admiral, after a timed wait and a block of text output. It touches the CIA chip registers and returns early unless the object is in its active state.

name: jump_to_object_phase_advance
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: resets a 16-bit phase counter, adds one to it when the phase byte equals four, then increments the phase byte and caps it at four.

name: advance_object_phase_byte_copy
description: The same phase advance as its sibling routine, used as a second entry.

name: jump_to_pending_object_spawn
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: waits for the blitter busy flag to clear, then walks the object list and assigns pending counts to unused entries with type values, decrementing the counts as it goes.

name: jump_to_pending_object_spawn
description: One-instruction entry that jumps to a shared routine; the body described is that routine: waits for the blitter busy flag to clear and assigns pending counts to unused entries of the object list, the same as its sibling routine.

description: Reads the keyboard serial register and runs about twenty-three helper calls that update the state of the game's objects and screen.

name: jump_to_object_list_walk

name: walk_object_list_update_entries

name: display_timed_alarm_message
description: Displays a timed text message through the text routines and waits on the CIA timer. The message text mentions an alarm.

name: wait_flag_pairs_until_zero
description: Waits twice per pass for a counter word to become nonzero, clearing it each time, and calls a helper after each pass while a register is nonzero.

name: draw_time_display_text
description: Draws a time display in hour, minute and second text fields, reading the CIA timer and polling the keyboard serial register.

name: draw_zero_padded_numbers
description: Blanks four text fields with spaces, then formats numeric values with a number format string and draws them through helper calls.

name: format_number_field_text
description: Scales two values down until the first is at most 399, then writes a number format string through a helper routine and increments a counter.

name: call_three_draw_helpers
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: step_color_words_toward_target
description: For a count of words, compares each 12-bit colour value with a target and steps its red, green and blue nibbles one unit toward the target.

name: decay_color_word_nibbles
description: For each nonzero 12-bit colour word in a list, reduces each of its three nibbles by one step toward zero.

name: write_pixel_pattern_bytes
description: Writes a computed pixel pattern into up to six byte locations derived from a pointer table, branching on a state flag.

name: update_numeric_text_fields
